run_cleandirs: run the script to delete checkpoint directories whose latest checkpoint file is missing
review_cleandirs: review the script that cleans up orphaned checkpoint directories by checking for missing checkpoints
refactor_cleandirs: refactor the script to accept a target directory path as a command line argument
summarize_cleandirs: summarize the script that finds checkpoint directories and removes those with missing latest checkpoints
test_cleandirs: test the script by creating mock checkpoint directories with and without the expected latest checkpoint
